<style>
:root {
  --paper: #f0ece4;         /* website background */
  --ink: #2e2825;           /* website text */
  --ink-soft: #6b6560;      /* softer text */
  --muted: #8a8278;         /* muted label text */
  --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  --panel-2: rgba(232, 227, 218, 0.7);  /* #e8e3da */
  --border: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.18);
  --shadow: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.12);

  /* restrained VC accents (keep premium, not neon) */
  --blue: #2f81f7;
  --green: #2da44e;
  --purple: #8250df;
  --rose: #7a3b35;          /* website accent */
}

.reveal {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.reveal .slides {
  text-align: left;
}

.reveal .slides section {
  background: radial-gradient(1100px 600px at 20% 10%, rgba(47, 129, 247, 0.09), rgba(47, 129, 247, 0) 60%),
              radial-gradient(900px 520px at 92% 22%, rgba(130, 80, 223, 0.10), rgba(130, 80, 223, 0) 58%),
              linear-gradient(180deg, #f6f2ec 0%, var(--paper) 40%, #efe9e0 100%);
  padding: 1.95rem 2.6rem !important;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.reveal h1, .reveal h2, .reveal h3 {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.reveal h1 { font-size: 2.4em; margin-bottom: 0.35em; }
.reveal h2 { font-size: 1.85em; margin-bottom: 0.5em; }
.reveal .slides section > h2:first-child { display: none; }
.reveal h3 { font-size: 1.15em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--rose); margin-bottom: 0.6em; }

.reveal p, .reveal li {
  font-size: 0.98em;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.reveal ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0.6em 0 0 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.reveal ul li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1.4em;
  margin-bottom: 0.55em;
}

.reveal ul li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0.55em;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--blue);
}

.reveal .slide-label {
  font-size: 0.62em;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--rose);
  margin-bottom: 0.6em;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.reveal .subtitle-line {
  font-size: 0.95em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-weight: 300;
  margin-bottom: 1.8em;
  max-width: 85%;
}

.reveal .callout {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--blue);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  margin: 1.2em 0;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 26px var(--shadow);
}

.reveal .callout-accent {
  border-left-color: var(--green);
}

.reveal .callout-purple {
  border-left-color: var(--purple);
}

.reveal .flow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin: 1.4em 0 0.8em;
}

.reveal .flow-step {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
  font-size: 0.72em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.reveal .flow-step.muted-step {
  color: var(--gray-text);
  border-color: var(--muted);
}

.reveal .flow-step.highlight {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.15);
}

.reveal .flow-step.highlight-green {
  border-color: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.15);
}

.reveal .flow-step.highlight-purple {
  border-color: var(--purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(188, 140, 255, 0.15);
}

.reveal .flow-arrow {
  color: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.45);
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: 300;
}

.reveal .pain-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: 1em;
}

.reveal .pain-tag {
  font-size: 0.62em;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  background: var(--panel-2);
}

.reveal .pain-tag.bad {
  border-color: rgba(168, 50, 40, 0.35);
  color: rgba(168, 50, 40, 0.95);
}

.reveal .pain-tag.good {
  border-color: var(--green);
  color: var(--green);
}

.reveal .segment-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  margin-top: 1em;
}

.reveal .segment-card {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.72em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.reveal .segment-card span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-top: 0.15em;
}

.reveal .segment-card.gem {
  border-color: var(--green);
}

.reveal .segment-card.low {
  border-color: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.14);
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.reveal .driver-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
  margin-top: 0.8em;
}

.reveal .driver-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.78em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.reveal .driver-bar {
  flex: 1;
  height: 4px;
  background: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.12);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.reveal .driver-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--purple));
}

.reveal .impact-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  margin: 1em 0;
}

.reveal .impact-item {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  font-size: 0.75em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.reveal .impact-item strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--green);
  font-size: 0.9em;
  margin-bottom: 0.2em;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.reveal .closing {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(47,129,247,0.10), rgba(130,80,223,0.10));
  border: 1px solid rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.16);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.4rem;
  margin-top: 1em;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.reveal .hero-stat {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 3.2em;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--blue);
  line-height: 1;
  margin: 0.3em 0 0.1em;
}

.reveal .hero-stat-label {
  font-size: 0.75em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.reveal .slide-footer-note {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 1.2rem;
  right: 3rem;
  font-size: 0.55em;
  color: var(--muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.reveal .progress { color: var(--blue); }
.reveal .slide-number { color: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.55); font-size: 0.55em; }
</style>

## Startup Overload

<div class="slide-label">The Problem</div>

# From Startup Chaos to Smart Deal Flow

<div class="subtitle-line">Using AI to Help VCs Pick Better Companies</div>

<div class="hero-stat">20,000+</div>
<div class="hero-stat-label">startups in the pipeline — time and attention are finite</div>

<div class="callout">
Imagine Shark Tank, but with 20,000 startups in a spreadsheet.
</div>

- VCs review thousands of pitches every year
- Partner time is the scarcest resource
- Most deals never get a real look
- Great companies get lost in the noise

## The Old Workflow

<div class="slide-label">Before AI</div>

# Manual, Slow, and Hard to Scale

<div class="flow">
  <div class="flow-step">CRM Data</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">Spreadsheets</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">Manual Research</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">PitchBook / Harmonic</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step muted-step">Gut Feeling</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step muted-step">Partner Review</div>
</div>

<div class="pain-tags">
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Slow</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Inconsistent</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Hard to Scale</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Data Silos</div>
</div>

<div class="callout callout-accent">
Every analyst does it differently. High-potential startups slip through because there simply isn't enough time to research them all.
</div>

## The AI-Assisted Workflow

<div class="slide-label">The Solution</div>

# AI Gives Deal Flow a Brain

<div class="flow">
  <div class="flow-step">CRM + Harmonic + PitchBook</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight">AI Summaries</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight">Investment Signals</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight-green">Relevance Scoring</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight-purple">Prioritized Deal Flow</div>
</div>

- External data unified into one view
- AI distills company narratives in seconds
- Signals surface thesis-fit opportunities automatically
- Partners review the *best* deals first — not just the loudest

<div class="callout callout-purple">
The workflow doesn't replace judgment — it front-loads intelligence so investors spend time where it matters.
</div>

## Segmentation

<div class="slide-label">Marketing Analytics · Unsupervised ML</div>

# Segment Startups, Not Customers

Instead of clustering buyers, we cluster companies in the deal pipeline — revealing natural groups that guide prioritization.

<div class="segment-grid">
  <div class="segment-card">High-Growth AI Startups<span>Rapid headcount & funding velocity</span></div>
  <div class="segment-card">Recently Funded<span>Fresh capital, active momentum</span></div>
  <div class="segment-card">Strong Investor-Backed<span>Top-tier VC syndicate signals</span></div>
  <div class="segment-card">Thesis-Fit Companies<span>Aligned with fund strategy</span></div>
  <div class="segment-card gem">Hidden Gems<span>Strong signals, low visibility</span></div>
  <div class="segment-card low">Low-Fit Companies<span>Deprioritize with confidence</span></div>
</div>

<div class="callout">
Unsupervised learning finds patterns humans miss — turning a flat spreadsheet into a structured map of opportunity.
</div>

## Key Drivers of Relevance

<div class="slide-label">Marketing Analytics · Supervised ML</div>

# What Drives a High Relevance Score?

Supervised models reveal *why* a startup ranks high — the same logic as key drivers analysis in marketing.

<div class="driver-list">
  <div class="driver-item">Thesis Fit <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:92%"></div></div></div>
  <div class="driver-item">Headcount Growth <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:78%"></div></div></div>
  <div class="driver-item">Recent Funding <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:71%"></div></div></div>
  <div class="driver-item">Investor Quality <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:68%"></div></div></div>
  <div class="driver-item">Founder / Team Strength <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:65%"></div></div></div>
  <div class="driver-item">Geography <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:48%"></div></div></div>
  <div class="driver-item">Prior Relationship <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:42%"></div></div></div>
</div>

<div class="callout callout-accent">
Key drivers turn a black-box score into an explainable investment signal — so partners trust and act on the ranking.
</div>

## Impact

<div class="slide-label">The Outcome</div>

# Focus Investors, Don't Replace Them

<div class="impact-grid">
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Less Manual Screening</strong>Automate the first pass across thousands of companies</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Faster Review</strong>AI summaries cut research time from hours to minutes</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Consistent Scoring</strong>Every deal evaluated with the same framework</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Better Data Use</strong>Harmonic, PitchBook, and CRM signals unified</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Easier Prioritization</strong>Ranked deal flow replaces gut-only triage</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Hidden Gems Found</strong>Strong startups surface before competitors notice</div>
</div>

<div class="closing">
This project applies marketing analytics thinking to venture capital: using AI, segmentation, and relevance scoring to turn messy deal flow into smarter investment decisions.
